reviews.title: Solid performance for its 2013 launch era
reviews.body: Picking this up around its release period, the Android 4.0 experience felt snappy and responsive for the price tier. The 1.3 MP camera delivered reliable shots in outdoor lighting.

reviews.title: Reliable battery and daily usability
reviews.body: The Li-Ion power cell paired with Vertu's software tuning easily lasted through a full work day with mixed web browsing, calls, and media playback.

reviews.title: Refined hardware styling and build
reviews.body: The physical chassis of the Vertu Ti feels well-balanced in hand. Its - make it easy to hold during long daily sessions.

reviews.title: Great value for the hardware specifications
reviews.body: For the price point, getting standard platform performance alongside 64GB storage, microSDHC made the Vertu Ti an easy recommendation among rivals in 2013.

reviews.title: Smooth day-to-day software responsiveness
reviews.body: Operating on Android 4.0, the user interface is intuitive with smooth system transitions. Core apps and browsing run without noticeable stutter.

reviews.title: Dependable display and audio clarity
reviews.body: The screen (Li-Ion, non-removable, 3.7", 480x800 pixels) produces vibrant colors for video streaming, and call clarity through the earpiece is crystal clear.

reviews.title: A well-rounded package from Vertu
reviews.body: Overall, the Vertu Ti proved to be a durable and well-engineered mobile device representing Vertu's design philosophy nicely.
